ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible ventral surface displays a high-contrast distribution with approximately 55% high-intensity white pixels and 45% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) blobs dominate the lateral regions of both lobes. A central low-intensity (black) region extends from the fluke base to the trailing edge, featuring jagged, high-frequency boundary transitions and scattered white mottling within the dark zone.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central notch with a narrow vertex; bounding-box depth is approximately 15-20% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with high-frequency variations (amplitude 2-8 pixels) interspersed with several deep macroscopic notches (amplitude 15-25 pixels) located primarily on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a consistent convex arc from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, textured white and brown pixel nodes are localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, near-parallel vertical high-intensity linear marks are visible on the left lobe, originating in the dark central pigmentation and extending upwards.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization at both distal fluke tips; irregular traumatic tearing and deep notches on the outer trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Secondary cetacean dorsal fin and partial back visible in the background water at the right-of-center coordinate.
